claims: The displayed rows are the exact Z/2 product action for the recorded parent rows and character.
Acceptance certifies row bounds, permutation shape, transitivity, involutions, and every finite Coxeter relation.
If the parent point stabilizer is torsion-free, the lifted point stabilizer is torsion-free because it is a subgroup of the parent stabilizer.
nonClaims: This algebraic constructor does not replay or inherit the parent action's external provenance.
The exact-z2-character-lift backend is not the packed-composite-permutation-module solver.
Acceptance does not by itself certify that the parent point stabilizer is torsion-free.
No lawful-subcomplex, Morse-link, asphericity, or virtual-fibering claim is made here.

claims: The finite quotient, wall system, canonical candidate sign maps, coface-closed retained cell counts, and inherited-metric flag checks are reconstructed from exact permutation rows.
The selected global pulling rule is vertex preserving. Every full or targeted link replay therefore declares an empty list of introduced subdivision vertices.
Each targeted replay reconstructs the exact ascending and descending connectivity components at the named quotient vertex under the global pulling and perturbed integral height rules.
nonClaims: A failed metric-flag certificate does not prove non-asphericity.
Compact directed-link output records exact vertex counts and component partitions. Its source-rooted digest can be replayed, but the report does not archive every graph edge or higher link simplex.
This calculation does not assert that the imported parent action has minimum index.
